Definition: properly, to cut off, i.e. (figuratively) to decree
BiblicalUsage: The word means to cut off or decree, and it stands at the head of Daniel's seventy weeks, determined upon his people and the holy city. The time is cut out and marked, not left open.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's decrees are measured out in advance, and the seventy weeks show He keeps His timetable even when His people cannot see it.
